slot.brief: Short family statement about a couple with sons/daughters and grandchildren; ask how many total members or how many males — must deduce gender from given clues.

stem: A family consists of a grandfather, grandmother, their two married sons, and one unmarried daughter. Each married son has two sons and one daughter. How many male members are there in the family?

verdicts.working: Males: grandfather (1) + two sons (2) + grandsons (2 sons × 2 sons each = 4) = 7. Grandmother, daughter, granddaughters (and daughters-in-law, if counted) are female.

working:
The male members of the family are:
1. The grandfather $= 1$
2. The two married sons $= 2$
3. The sons of the two married sons $= 2 \times 2 = 4$

Total number of male members $= 1 + 2 + 4 = 7$.

(Note: The female members are the grandmother (1), the wives of the two sons (2), the unmarried daughter (1), and the daughters of the two sons ($2 \times 1 = 2$), giving 6 females and 13 total members.)
